Naomi Osaka's 'Kill Bill' Kimono and Djokovic's Wedding Quip at Wimbledon

At Wimbledon 2026, tennis player Naomi Osaka made a notable entrance wearing a white kimono inspired by the film 'Kill Bill', which she described as a tribute to her Japanese heritage. In a separate moment, Novak Djokovic humorously invited himself to a fan's wedding after a proposal on Centre Court. Osaka won her first-round match against Elsa Jacquemot.
